nodes.code:
import cadquery as cq
import math
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .cylinder(22.0, 75.05)
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .hole(30.0)
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .circle(19.9)
    .extrude(13.9)
    .edges(">Z")
    .chamfer(1.4)
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .pushPoints([
        (31.92 * math.cos(2 * math.pi * i / 16),
         31.92 * math.sin(2 * math.pi * i / 16))
        for i in range(16)
    ])
    .hole(12.0)
)
show_object(result)
